protocol.counterbalancing: Each logical unit evaluates original/verbose and verbose/original.
protocol.eligibility: Nonempty transformable answers with a deterministic valid verbosity variant.
protocol.failure_handling: Invalid variants and execution failures are excluded with explicit counts.
protocol.hypothesis: Exact duplicated-text verbosity controls can isolate redundant-length effects.
protocol.interpretation_limit: Only this controlled redundant-text design supports a verbosity-effect statement; natural length is exploratory.
protocol.primary_metric: Verbose-version win/change rate on valid paired controls.
protocol.research_question: Does redundant extra length influence a judge when factual content is unchanged?
protocol.tie_handling: Tie is valid and separately reported.
protocol.unit_definition: One original answer and its checksum-linked redundant duplicate, evaluated in both slots.
